svg.title: Announcing Prisma ORM 7.2.0
svg.desc: A typographic release cover on light paper: the numeral 7.2.0 set large in ink above a cyan rule and a one-line summary of the release — the --url flag is back, prisma init is runtime aware, and @db.Money is fixed.

g.text: --url is back · runtime-aware prisma init · @db.Money fixed
